text:
Everyone else found great doctors while we didn't. So sad. After reading reviews, I thought that if we went for general treatment, we would definitely get a good doctor because the doctor gave great advice during our first consultation.
The staff deserves 5 million stars; the service from the staff was so lovely until we encountered the specialist. It was a complete nightmare. I'm deducting 1 star for that. *This is just my personal opinion.* I don't know if everyone else experienced the same thing, but the doctor was very pushy and didn't give good advice. Their communication skills were poor; they spoke too fast and were difficult to understand until we talked to the counter staff and assistant. I recommend booking for general treatment, like fillings and things like that. The female doctor we saw was very nice, but root canal treatment here might not be ideal yet.
